summary: The joints between the road setts now read as grooves between raised stones in every condition of the lighting test set. A new layer JOINTS (after the round 2 wetness layer, on the road material only) makes the joint darker, duller and gives the stone edge a rounded slope the water cannot flatten; the wet look (glossy stone tops, puddles, reflections) is kept. On the 22-picture lighting test set (all drawn on the rented RTX 4090 machine, before and after in the same run) round 2 passes 6 of 22 (only the dry ones) and the new layer passes 21 of 22; at the painter's size (1536 x 2730, 48 samples) all 9 pictures drawn pass. The one remaining failure is the lockout shot in heavy rain, middle band, at 540 x 960 (joints there are lit edges under the brazier, not dark lines; passes at plate size). A second flaw was found and fixed on the way: the study's joint picture only found dark-moss joints and missed about half of the pale-sand joints, so I rebuilt it as a complete grid. Real 8 mm grooves cut into the near road were built as an optional plate-only variant (best in a low close view, worse in the middle distance); left off by default. Not done: painter repaint (paid, needs your go-ahead), glb/stage, pavement flags and kerbs, Cycles. The rubbish mask is not part of this round.
what_changed: NO file of set_copy/ or the film project was changed. The street copy's road material 'street_setts' gets the new layer at run time through setts/tools/apply_joints_to_set.py (aj.apply() after aw.apply(); aj.remove() undoes it; tested). 1) New layer JOINTS (node group, setts/tools/joint_layer.py) chained WETNESS -> JOINTS -> Principled BSDF: joint colour x (1 - 0.30 x cavity); stone edge x (1 - 0.15 x halo); roughness in joint toward 0.9; specular x (1 - 0.35 x dull); coat x (1 - 0.45 x dull); the wetness layer's normal plus a rounded-groove relief picture (8 mm deep, edge sigma 2.5 dots, steepest 51 degrees; relief x1.0), the photo's own relief taken out inside the joint (1.0); puddle cover 0.8 (dulling and slope cut by 0.8 x puddle mask, dark colour kept); relief fade with camera distance (Relief Far Share 0.10, 5 m to 20 m); Joint Strength 1 master dial (0 = round 2 exactly: verified, mean abs difference 0.004 of 255 over 22 pictures). Joint Shadow 0, Joint Wet Darkening 0 (dials kept, off). 2) New pictures (setts/maps/, made by setts/tools/make_joint_pictures.py): sett_joints_clean.png (red cavity, green groove profile, blue halo; 2048 x 2048, 1 mm a dot, seamless over the 2 m repeat), sett_groove_normal_16bit.png (the groove relief picture), joint_cores_new.png, joint_grid_check.jpg. The picture now has a COMPLETED GRID: the study's dark-line search found 91 vertical stretches; 10 gaps were filled and 53 vertical stretches drawn or extended, 72 short horizontal stretches added (rows at 4, 211, 420, 619, 821, 1022, 1226, 1431, 1636, 1840), line width 16 dots; cleaning: bridge 6 cm (was 8.5), fill stone islands under 6000 dots (was 1500). Joint share 8.5 % -> 14.6 % (lines) -> 21 % (soft mask). 3) Optional plate-only variant 'real grooves' (Geometry Nodes modifier JOINTS REAL GROOVES on street_setts: faces of the road between y 0 and 22 m subdivided 6 levels, joints pressed down 8 mm by the groove profile, full depth to 10 m, fading to 0 at 22 m, Set Shade Smooth; JOINTS relief set to 0 with it): aj.apply_real_grooves(); off by default. 4) Tools to draw and judge (setts/tools): make_job_lists.py (any list or whole set x variants), rent_and_render.py + run_jobs_rented.sh + run_two.sh (run on the rented machine, tar download), sweep_report.py, before_after_sheet.py, measure_grid_visibility.py (second measure), test_apply_script.py, register_variants.py, apply_joints_after_wetness.py. The materials of walls, pavements, kerbs, gutters, roofs were not touched. Settings compared: mild = Joint Strength 0.6; strong = darkness 0.45, relief 1.4, edge shade 0.25.
controls: JOINTS dials (short name; range; chosen): strength 0-1 chosen 1 (master; 0 = off = round 2 exactly; 0.6 mild); darkness 0-1 0.30 (joint colour x 1-darkness); wet_darkening 0-1 0 (extra darkness x wetness); shadow 0-1 0 (share of light that never reaches a joint; 0.25-0.7 tried: black net; only works if >0 when applied); dullness 0-1 1; spec_cut 0-1 0.35; coat_cut 0-1 0.45; dull_roughness 0-1 0.9; relief 0-2 1 (groove slope; 1.4 strong; 0 none); edge_shade 0-1 0.15; puddle_cover 0-1 0.8; photo_relief_in_joints 0-1 1; far_share 0-1 0.10 (share of the slope left far away; 1 = no fade); fade_start metres 5; fade_end metres 20. Python: aj.apply(**dials), aj.set_dials(**dials), aj.apply_real_grooves(y_min=0, y_full=10, y_max=22, level=6, depth=0.008), aj.remove().
